notes: -ffp-contract=off stops GCC from fusing a * b + c into an FMA (the default x86-64 baseline has none anyway).
Each row is packed into a reused std::vector<unsigned char> and written with std::ostream::write.
std::from_chars parses without locale or exceptions; digits are validated first.
g++ -O2, statically linked and stripped, running on a scratch image.
